description: Dated analyst assumptions from the 12-stock AshStocks discussion, not reported EPS, company guidance, broker consensus or validated AshStock forecasts. Reference prices are the user's supplied prices, not verified live quotes. Sources supply research context, not these target assumptions. No corporate-action basis is approved and no sell target is active by importing this file. Do not apply these company-specific assumptions to other stocks or silently refresh their reference dates.

assumptions.notes: BBL means Bharat Bijlee. Assumed annual EPS of Rs 110 requires earnings and Power Systems margin recovery; P/E 22-25 is an analyst valuation choice, not company guidance. Bear EPS 85 and P/E 19 are a downside sensitivity, not a price floor. The reference price was supplied by the user.
assumptions.corporate_action_basis: UNVERIFIED: confirm reference price and annual EPS on the same current share/split/bonus basis before activation.
